title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.35684v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbi

translated_title: OmniShowcase：基于多视角图像的全向主体一致性视频生成
translated_abstract: 从少量参考图像生成特定主体的视频在相机拍到输入中不可见表面时仍然极具挑战性。早期的主体到视频（S2V）方法仅以单张参考图像为条件，因此必须随视角变化推断主体不可见的外观和几何结构。为解决这一局限，最近的方法将S2V扩展到多个参考视角，从不同视点提供更多关于主体的信息。然而，这些方法并未显式指定连接这些观测的3D结构。此外，现有训练数据无法保证视角变化保持同一底层3D主体。我们提出OmniShowcase，其构建于两个核心组件之上：（i）一个全自动的数据合成流水线，能够沿多样化的相机轨迹生成训练视频，视角变化由底层主体几何驱动，甚至涵盖完整的360度环绕轨道运动……
tldr: 该论文提出OmniShowcase框架，通过全自动数据合成流水线和显式的3D主体几何结构建模，实现了从多视角参考图像生成覆盖完整360度视角的主体一致性视频。
en_tdlr: OmniShowcase enables omnidirectional subject-consistent video generation from multi-view images by combining a fully automated data synthesis pipeline with explicit 3D subject geometry, supporting full 360-degree camera orbits.
